label: Approve the design
description: The most consequential gate in the workflow: an approved architecture amendment changes what every later feature is measured against, so it is decided separately from the units and no score resolves it (feature.md §4).

binding.text:
This is the engineering design: the units and their invariants, the contracts they own, and — where one is present — an amendment to architecture.md.

approve — implementation starts from these unit docs, and any amendment lands.
revise — back to draft with your comments.
escalate — this is not decidable here; the phase stops and the decision goes up.

An architecture amendment is decided separately from the units. If you approve the units but not the amendment, say so in the comments and choose revise.

inputs.contracts.description: The contract entries themselves — id, owner unit, surface, compatibility answer. Not paths: these come from the drafting state, before anything is written.

inputs.reasons.description: Shown instead of the bare number: 0.62 tells a person nothing.

inputs.must_ask.description: Non-empty means ask regardless of score.
